status: working requirements and offline sample; not a deployed engine
source: Captain's explicit HouseHull quote and invoice direction
househull_operator: person measuring and estimating the work
househull_customer_output: reviewed customer quote PDF; invoice when explicitly issued for the appropriate business event

header: unique readable number at top right
totals: configured tax and other explicit adjustments
invoice payments applied and remaining balance where applicable
invoice_only: related quote document ID and exact revision when applicable
shared_pattern.currency_rule: Currency is explicit per document; decimal calculations and a documented rounding rule. Never silently assume a tax rate or jurisdiction.
shared_pattern.sample_decimal_rule: Quantities times unit selling prices are rounded to currency cents with ROUND_HALF_UP at each line; line amounts sum to subtotal. The sample tax is then rounded to cents.

parts_and_ordering.ordering_quantity: Physical material quantity is expressed in its purchasable unit: carton, piece, roll, box, tube or each.
parts_and_ordering.measured_quantity: Retain measured/required quantity separately from ordering quantity and package conversion.
parts_and_ordering.part_identity: Actual manufacturer/supplier part numbers, vendor and catalog revision must be stored exactly. Internal item ID, supplier SKU and manufacturer part number are distinct fields when needed.
parts_and_ordering.specification: Show the variant, color, profile, size, stock length or pack coverage needed to identify the item unambiguously.
parts_and_ordering.unit_price: The displayed unit price multiplies the displayed ordering or billing unit.
parts_and_ordering.service_codes: Service references identify labor or other billed work; they are not physical manufacturer part numbers.
parts_and_ordering.invoice_vs_order: A quoted or invoiced quantity does not itself establish a supplier order, delivery, installation or payment. Ordering is a separate explicit workflow.

numbering.internal_identity: globally unique immutable document ID plus immutable business ID
numbering.position: top right on every PDF page
numbering.uniqueness: business-scoped type/year/sequence policy backed by atomic allocation; business prefix resolves unambiguously; internal UUID is independent of display code
numbering.idempotency: Repeated submission of the same issuance operation returns the same document and number.
numbering.reuse: Do not reuse canceled or voided numbers.
numbering.revision: Issued snapshots remain fixed. The document number and visible revision identify the version; re-export of that version retains both.
numbering.quote_to_invoice: Explicit action creates a separately numbered invoice referencing the exact source quote ID and revision; never mutate the quote into an invoice.
numbering.implementation_status: Requirements recorded. The offline renderer accepts supplied sample numbers; production allocation and issuance are not implemented.

business_scope.optional_fields: Part number may be a supplier SKU, manufacturer part, internal item reference or service code depending on the business. Use an appropriate label and show only relevant fields.
business_scope.privacy: Sharing a document pattern does not copy another business's customer details, prices, margins, rates, photos or scope-specific rules.
business_scope.activation: No automatic quote approval, invoice issuance, sending, ordering, ledger entry or Fleet authority grant.
